confidence: Low to moderate. Brie has the clearest admitted glass contact; Chip has bottle handling. Motive-heavy alternatives remain viable without timed movements or confirmation.
plausibility_notes: Brie rescuing an invoice while moving a sauce-spattered glass is a believable work action and a meaningful opportunity, not proof of guilt.
Custody-band stock and metallic performance paper sharing a cabinet prevent me from treating red material alone as distinctive.
The sequence of thirty admissions again feels organized around universal wrongdoing. Individual acts are often plausible, but the repeated structure makes the ensemble less natural.
Cary provides a potentially independently witnessed lift delay; most other location claims are too untimed to eliminate anyone.
